support_claim: The billing record names Vellum Print Co Ltd and SOW-VEL-2022 lists Vellum Print Co Ltd as counterparty, but neither observation establishes identity between the billing referent and the contract referent.
justification: Under the identity_judgment contract, SAME_ENTITY requires evidence that establishes identity and DISTINCT requires evidence that establishes distinctness; the packet only shows the same name appearing in billing and in the SOW header, which is name compatibility rather than identity-establishing evidence, and no observation demonstrates that billing:Vellum Print Co Ltd and contract:SOW-VEL-2022 are distinct legal counterparties.
